title: Sable and the Hollow
premise: Marguerite Ishikawa has spent her life as the last keeper of the Hollow Gate, a seal between the human valley and a starving fae realm, bound by a covenant that demands she never leave and never love. When a dying stranger named Sable staggers through with a map of the gate's true architecture, she learns her order's founders built the seal to fail — and that the breach will open in nine days. To reforge the covenant, Marguerite must break her vows, cross into the Hollow with Sable, and offer something the old keepers never dared: a shared sacrifice rather than a single life. In the end, they bind themselves to each other across both realms, sealing the gate at the cost of their separate worlds — but not of each other.
about_author: Yara Blackwood is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing border-town folklore before turning to fiction. She writes fantasy about thresholds — geographic, moral, and romantic — from a cottage she insists is on no map.

chapters.title: The Keeper's Valley
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. We meet the valley where magic cannot follow, her solitary rounds along the Hollow Gate, and the ritual that has defined every day of her life. A tremor in the seal hints the covenant is weakening. Emotional beat: quiet dread beneath routine — she suspects her order lied to her, and loneliness sharpens into suspicion.

chapters.title: A Stranger Bleeding Through
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. Sable crashes through the gate's outer ward, mortally wounded, clutching a map inked in two languages — one of them hers by bloodline. Saving him means breaking the rule against bringing magic-touched things inside. Emotional beat: reluctant compassion; her first act of disobedience in twenty years, done without letting herself decide to do it.

chapters.title: What the Map Refuses to Show
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. Recovering, he reveals he was sent by remnants of the fae court to find the gate's keystone — and that his people are dying as the seal starves their realm. He conceals one detail: the reforging requires a keeper's willing death. Emotional beat: guilt sharpening into resolve; he begins to care for Marguerite and hates what his mission may cost her.

chapters.title: Nine Days
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. The map confirms the breach date: nine days. They decode the covenant together and discover the founders designed it to fail, harvesting the Hollow's magic for the valley's prosperity. Emotional beat: shared fury and growing intimacy — two strangers becoming conspirators, then something neither names.

chapters.title: The Elders' Silence
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. She confronts the valley council, keepers in name only, who admit the truth and demand she die as intended to preserve their comfort. They confiscate the map. Emotional beat: betrayal crystallizing into defiance; belonging, she realizes, was always conditional — and she was never truly one of them.

chapters.title: Crossing Without Permission
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. They steal back the map and slip through the gate together into the Hollow: a beautiful, rotting realm where Sable's past waits. His estranged sister leads the remnant court and does not trust him. Emotional beat: homecoming as wound; Sable must face that he left this place to save himself once already.

chapters.title: The Court of Ashes
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. Before the fae court, Marguerite offers a new covenant — mutual sacrifice instead of a keeper's death. The court demands proof of good faith: a trial in which each must surrender their deepest anchor. Marguerite nearly loses her memories of the valley; Sable breaks the trial to shield her. Emotional beat: love declared through action, duty and desire finally aligned.

chapters.title: The Breach Opens Early
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. The valley elders, fearing loss of power, attempt to force the gate open themselves to harvest the Hollow directly. The breach tears wide; Hollow creatures spill toward the valley, and the court blames the keepers' line. Emotional beat: catastrophe and clarity — the true enemy is greed on both sides, and only the two of them stand at the seam.

chapters.title: The Reforging
chapters.summary: Climax, alternating POVs. At the failing keystone, Marguerite and Sable perform the new covenant: each offering half a life, bound to each other and to both realms, so neither world feeds on the other again. The elders' faction attacks mid-rite; Sable's sister chooses him at last and holds them off. Emotional beat: terror transmuted into vow — the price of survival paid jointly, not singly.

chapters.title: Two Shores, One Gate
chapters.summary: Resolution, Marguerite's POV. The gate holds, now a bridge rather than a wall, tended by keepers from both realms. The valley must learn to live without stolen magic; the Hollow slowly greens. Marguerite and Sable walk its threshold together, belonging fully to neither shore and wholly to each other. Emotional beat: hard-won peace — survival was never meant to be paid alone.
